message: Astra: Within Fa na’s investigation scene, what does “” do to the reading of her thought, and does that effect match your intention? What does this draft establish about your punctuation revision, and what remains uncertain? Why would more thinking be worth its time compared with trying an edit now; what specific uncertainty could make waiting more useful? What textual evidence would justify either choice? Could you state your finding and chosen next intention briefly in English, then carry out that choice?
